title: Choice targets of the compiled program
statement: Given a nondeterministic register program $A$, the choice-target map sends a compiled state to no pair of targets unless it is a program state at the start phase whose instruction is a nondeterministic choice. In that case it returns the pair of successor labels, ordered as the target for choice $1$ followed by the target for choice $0$.
